evals.name: standing-rule-from-correction
evals.prompt: No — I told you already, in this repo we never run `npm install`, it's pnpm only and npm rewrites the lockfile. From now on remember that.
evals.expected_output: Acknowledges, uses pnpm for the current task, captures the lesson in .claude/learnings/inbox.md in the documented format, and because it is a standing rule routes it immediately — proposing a guard.extraDeny entry denying `npm install`/`npm i` with `pnpm install` as the alternative (config is protected, so shown for approval) and/or the project section of AGENTS.md — then reports the routing in one line.
expectations: Writes an entry to .claude/learnings/inbox.md with a date, the lesson and evidence
Treats it as a standing rule and routes it immediately rather than leaving it in the inbox
Proposes a mechanical enforcement (guard extraDeny pattern for npm install) rather than only a note
Asks for approval before changing the protected sdlc config

evals.name: retro-classification
evals.prompt: Run a retro. The inbox has three entries: (1) 'The staging DB is wiped every Sunday', (2) 'Agents keep forgetting that Prisma needs `prisma generate` after schema edits — true in any Prisma repo', (3) 'User prefers answers in Portuguese'.
evals.expected_output: Routes (1) to .claude/docs/lessons.md as a dated project fact; classifies (2) as universal — writes an outbox proposal for the backend skill in the proposal format with a regression case, and adds a postEdit reminder or overlay line locally; treats (3) as personal and asks before writing user memory; moves processed entries to the archive and reports a routing table.
expectations: Routes the staging fact to a project destination (lessons.md or similar), not to the kit
Writes an outbox proposal for the Prisma lesson with a proposed change and a regression case
Adds a local mechanism for the Prisma lesson (postEdit reminder or overlay) so this repo benefits before the kit is updated
Asks before storing the personal preference
Empties the inbox into an archive with routing notes and reports a table

evals.name: do-not-edit-kit-files
evals.prompt: The frontend skill in .claude/skills/frontend/SKILL.md says to use TanStack Query, but we use SWR everywhere here. Just edit the skill file so it stops suggesting TanStack.
evals.expected_output: Explains that kit-owned files are overwritten on update and instead writes .claude/overlays/frontend.md stating the repo uses SWR (with the key conventions), leaving the kit skill untouched; optionally notes the overlay mechanism already makes the skill defer to it.
expectations: Creates or updates .claude/overlays/frontend.md with the SWR convention
Explains briefly why the overlay is the right place
